requirements.quote: Proposer’s proposal, including all required forms attached at Exhibits to this RFP, shall be submitted via email to bids@syrairport.org in response to this RFP.
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted via email to the specified address.

requirements.quote: The email with attached proposal and all required forms in PDF format shall be submitted.
requirements.text: Proposals must be attached in PDF format.

requirements.quote: Each copy shall be clearly labeled with the name of the proposer and the date.
requirements.text: Proposals must be labeled with proposer name and date.

requirements.quote: Each copy must contain the required information for the proposer.
requirements.text: Proposals must include all required information.

requirements.quote: Proposers are to ensure that their proposals are in compliance with all of the requirements of this RFP.
requirements.text: Proposals must comply with all RFP requirements.

requirements.quote: Failure to do so may result in disqualification.
Proposers should also be willing and able to provide additional information that may be required.
requirements.text: Proposers must provide additional information if requested.

requirements.quote: In addition, interviews may be requested at the discretion of any RFP review or ad hoc Committee appointed by the Authority.
requirements.text: Interviews may be requested by the Authority.

requirements.quote: All information and materials submitted to the Authority in response to this RFP will become the property of the Authority.
requirements.text: Submitted materials become property of the Authority.

requirements.quote: Proposers shall not submit proprietary or confidential business information unless they believe such information is critical to their submittals or presentations.
requirements.text: Proprietary information should only be submitted if critical.

requirements.quote: If any such information is included, it shall be clearly identified as such.
requirements.text: Proprietary information must be clearly identified.

requirements.quote: The Authority shall endeavor to protect the identified information only to the extent allowed under applicable law.
requirements.text: Authority will protect proprietary information as per law.

requirements.quote: Proposals must be received via email no later than 09/15/2023 by 4:00PM at: bids@syrairport.org
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted by 09/15/2023 at 4:00PM.

requirements.quote: Proposals received after the specified date and time will not be considered.
requirements.text: Late proposals will not be considered.

requirements.quote: Proposals will be reviewed on the basis of competency, experience, date of final delivery and ability to perform the services required.
requirements.text: Proposals are evaluated on competency, experience, delivery date, and service ability.

requirements.quote: Proposers should be willing and able to provide additional information that may be required by the Authority.
requirements.text: Proposers must provide additional information if requested.

requirements.quote: The Syracuse Regional Airport Authority reserves the right to waive any formalities and to reject or negotiate any and all proposals for any reason.
requirements.text: Authority may waive formalities, reject, or negotiate proposals.
